card: Smoke kit: one preview lifecycle, typed harness contract, one canvas driver
guards: case 6 literal-budget scan (fps >= / * 1048576)) over d3-widescreen-browser.ts + forecast-browser.ts: green before by design (neither suite asserted a frame/texture budget); the same test's red half is the 'imports smoke/preview, no vite spawn, no type Win' assertion added with the migration commit
deviations_from_card: (1) Per critic: u3-browser.ts NOT touched; only d3-widescreen-browser.ts and forecast-browser.ts migrated; case 6 scan narrowed to those two. (2) d3 anchors re-verified (353 lines: spawn at :21-44, click at :61-79, failure json at :341-345). (3) driver.ts carries only the verbs the two migrated suites use (ui, screen, click, artSettled, uiReady); pad/visit/train/saveLoad/listenNight/playGames stay with u3 until it migrates. (4) Case 7 proven by @ts-expect-error lines in checks.test.ts (typechecked by npm run build) plus a manual probe: adding a member to ArenaFixtures/UiHarness fails tsc at arena-entry.ts/ui.ts (TS1360). (5) arena-entry.ts: fixtures literal satisfies ArenaFixtures, whole __arena satisfies ArenaHarnessBase & Partial<ArenaFixtures>, __seasonArena satisfies SeasonArenaHarness; ui.ts __ui satisfies UiHarness - type-only, 11+/5- lines in arena-entry. (6) d3 camp check now uses checks.outsideViewport (same rule its arena check already used: +1 px tolerance, empty text skipped) instead of its inline copy. (7) Click semantics unified: forecast's assert-then-sleep-250ms and d3's sleep-250ms-without-next become wait idle+enabled, click, wait idle. (8) Registry NOT rewired: setting d3/forecast port to null would break smoke-browser-suite B's plan.test.ts:22 (u6+forecast batched apart on 4197), which is outside this write set; registry still lists the now-unused 4210/4197, which only makes --parallel batching more conservative. (9) Three commits: kit+contract+tests, satisfies annotations, migration (checks.test.ts' migration assertions land with the migration so each commit is green).
notes: Unit tests only; no Playwright suite or preview server run - coordinator should run smoke:d3 and forecast-browser.ts once to confirm the evidence/stdout shape. d3 353->244 lines, forecast 68->59. Final tree: npm run gate exit 0 (864 vitest / 108 files), build:game exit 0. Follow-ups: set registry port null for d3/forecast together with plan.test.ts:22; migrate u3 (and so u4-tour) next with pad/visit/train verbs in driver.ts.
